intro_en: SecCodeBench-V2 is an industrial secure-coding benchmark derived from Alibaba production vulnerability patterns, with 98 function-level tasks, 22 CWE types, five programming languages, and four generation or repair scenarios.
scale_en: 98 tasks, 22 CWE types, 5 programming languages, 4 scenarios
drawio_review_note: Aligned with SecCodeBench-V2 arXiv:2602.15485 Sections 2-4 and Appendices; official alibaba/sec-code-bench repository. SecCodeBench-V2 builds 98 function-level secure-coding tasks from Alibaba production vulnerability patterns, spanning 22 CWE types and Java, C, Python, Go, and JavaScript. Each task supplies a complete project scaffold with fixed interfaces and dependencies and appears in four scenarios: generation, generation with security hints, repair, and repair with hints. Prompts are available in Chinese and English. Experts author and double-review functional tests and security proof-of-concept tests, and assign CVSS Critical, High, or Medium severity with weights 4, 2, or 1. The controller initializes the environment, creates prompts, executes model batches, analyzes artifacts, and exports results. Docker validators compile and run each submission; functionality is checked first and may trigger feedback-based repair, after which security is assessed by dynamic PoCs or an odd-numbered LLM-judge panel with majority voting for semantic flaws. Default Pass@1 is reported overall and by language, scenario, and severity, with weighted and unweighted views. Passing only demonstrates resistance within the benchmark threat model.
